description.en: Casebase intake and anonymization QA desk for law-firm judgment and arbitral award documents: agent-prepared case records, canonical case-library groupings, deterministic QA checks, and a review queue (approve / request changes / revise / block) before a record becomes a searchable knowledge asset
description.zh-CN: 面向律所判决书与仲裁裁决文书的案例库录入与脱敏质检台：Agent 整理好的案例记录、规范化的案例库分组、规则化质检检查，以及记录成为可检索知识资产前的审核队列（通过 / 打回修改 / 需修订 / 拦截）。
